title: La Vergne Townhome: 22 Mi to Dtwn Nashville!
description:
Looking for a comfy place to call home outside of the city? Look no further than this 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome in La Vergne. The vacation rental is ideally located to enjoy the best of both worlds. Spend outdoorsy days at Percy Priest Lake where you can go fishing, boating, and sit down for waterfront dining. When you have an itch for big-city adventures, venture into Nashville and explore the Music City, packed with family-friendly attractions, museums, music events, and more.

The space
Pet Friendly w/ Fee | 6 Mi to Percy Priest Lake | Free WiFi

Bedroom 1: Queen Bed | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed

HOME FEATURES: Flat-screen TV, laptop-friendly workspace, dining table
KITCHEN: Stainless steel appliances, drip coffee maker, microwave, knife block, stove/oven, refrigerator
GENERAL: Washer/dryer, linens/towels, complimentary toiletries, central air conditioning
FAQ: Stairs required to access, pet fee (paid pre-trip)
PARKING: Designated parking spot (2 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via lockbox

Other things to note
- No smoking
- Pet friendly w/ $50 fee (+ fees & taxes)
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
- NOTE: The property requires 1 step to enter, and internal stairs to access all bedrooms
